correctness.rationale: For the 12-vertex icosahedron, the distance shells have 30,30,6 unordered pairs at distances 1,2,3. Six antipodal pairs give S1=T²−p+2C and S2=T²−p−2C, where a complete six-variable signed extremum table gives S1≥−10, S2≥−10, 3S1+S2≥−24 and S1+3S2≥−24 with sharp equality families. Their nonnegative linear combinations give the exact lower envelope on all r>0; equality counts are 60,80,20,80,60 and all minimizers have zero magnetization. Independently reconstructed all 30 edges, graph distances and all 2^12=4096 spin states; rational r in all five regimes reproduced energies, degeneracies and magnetization exactly. Since this enumerates the whole finite Ising state space and supporting inequalities hold for all real positive r, it is exhaustive for the stated finite system.

value.rationale: The isolated finite cluster is a canonical frustrated spin system. An exact two-interaction phase diagram, critical degeneracies and correlation cusps are nontrivial exact finite invariants that distinguish competing antipodal arrangements and can benchmark physical or combinatorial models.
